say:2:1631511001:0.text: Enough with the treasure! Look, I can smell rabbits nearby, and that's what we should focus on instead of chasing rainbows.
say:2:1631511001:0.source_cn: 哼，传闻都是假的，我闻到几十米外有兔子的香味，那才是真的。

say:5:1631511003:0.text: If we have our <style="highlight">ancestors' blessing</style>, a <style="highlight">hidden entrance</style> will reveal itself deep in the forest!
